# High-level design (HLD)

System design rounds test whether you can turn a vague product prompt into a justified architecture in 45 minutes. This section has two parts: the fundamentals explain the building blocks and the trade-offs behind them; the case studies apply them to the systems interviewers actually ask for. Work through the P0 fundamentals, then the P0 case studies, then use the mock interviews to rehearse against the clock.

## Sections

- [Fundamentals](fundamentals/index.md) - 27 pages: the concepts and trade-offs every case study builds on
- [Case studies](case-studies/index.md) - 31 pages: the systems interviewers ask for, solved end to end
